functions.name: ssot_propose_change
functions.description: Open a Draft change request on a rule, constraint or calc in the SSOT Editor. Never releases anything.

functions.name: simplex_request_approval
functions.description: Ask a human to approve a binding or irreversible action. Returns a pending approval ID; nothing executes until approved.

functions.name: simplex_status
functions.description: Get the status of an approval request.

functions.name: run_action_proposer
functions.description: Ask the hosted Action Proposer (AG-38) to do its job: Which action to propose to a human owner. It runs under its circuit breaker and returns its decision, options considered, citations and whether a person must decide.
